Two nonnegative deficits from their own average sum to zero only when both vanish.

For the proper branch, the fair endpoint choice from twice the midpoint law plus the residual diagonal has the exact given source and target, so the log difference is twice the old pair gap. The convex extension of negative log of a positive piecewise affine concave L can be made by extending each affine denominator's negative logarithm below min L by its tangent and taking the maximum.

Multiplying the repaired branch law by two doubles both the discounted part and error, with no assertion that the residual fits the same capacity or that a feasible discounted coupling exists.
